The people behind the launches

Meet the club.

Instructors, tow pilots, maintainers, organizers, and members who keep FLSC moving.

Experience shared freely

Soaring is a team sport.

The club’s strength lives in members who teach, tow, maintain aircraft, run operations, and welcome the next generation of pilots.

Jim Martin

Chief Instructor · CFI-G · DPE · Tow Pilot

Jim began soaring at Dansville at 11, later serving as a USAF fighter and test pilot and as an experimental and certification pilot. He brings more than 15,000 flight hours and a lifelong passion for teaching.

Jeri Wallach

Club President · CFI-G · Tow Pilot

A powered pilot since 1991 and glider pilot since 1995, Jeri instructs, tows, and flies an HPH 304C when club responsibilities leave an opening.

Rick Lafford

Secretary · CFI-G · Tow Pilot

Rick’s first glider flight at Dansville in 1977 set the hook. He has instructed for decades, flies an RV-6, tows, and serves as a primary club contact.

Cy Kastner

Chief Tow Pilot · Receiving Treasurer · Board

A glider pilot, longtime tow pilot, and aerospace engineer, Cy devotes substantial time to the club’s two tow aircraft and the operation behind every launch.

Rick Roman

Commercial Pilot · Disbursing Treasurer

FLSC’s primary ride pilot is known for smooth introductory flights—and for keeping the fleet’s radios and electronics working.

Linda Evenski

Vice President · CFI-G · Safety Officer · Board

Linda began flying at 11 with her father, Kai Gertsen, and grew up around soaring contests. After flying gliders in England and Spain, she returned to instruction.

Joseph Somers

Pilot · Maintenance Officer

A former Navy aircraft mechanic, Joe joined after earning his glider certificate and now helps keep the club fleet current and airworthy.

Hans Schoenenberger

Glider Pilot · Board

Originally from Switzerland and retired from an environmental instrumentation career, Hans brings energy to flying and club support work.

Judith Galbraith

Board Member

Helping guide the club and support its long-term continuity.

Eloy Yague-Spaude, PhD

Board Member

Serving the club’s members and mission through board leadership.
